 Plea In Madras High Court Seeks Official Information Regarding Health Condition of Kolathur MLA VS Babu
 Upasana Sajeev 
 18 Nov 2026 5:22 PM IST
 Share this 
 Listen to this Article A plea has been filed in the Madras High Court seeking official information regarding the health condition of Kolathur MLA VS Babu. It may be noted that VS Babu emerged victorious in the 2026 Assembly Elections from Kolathur Assembly Constituency, defeating former Chief Minister MK Stalin.
 The petition has been filed by G Devarajan, a resident of Kolathur Constituency. 
 The petitioner argued that as per media reports, VS Babu was admitted to MGM Healthcare in Chennai for intensive medical treatment due to sudden breathing difficulties. He submitted that on the next day, the hospital had issued a statement that Babu's health condition was stable and that he was expected to return home within a day or two.
 The petitioner argued that there has been no subsequent and officially confirmed public communication regarding Babu's present health condition. The petitioner submitted that as per media reports, a medical procedure known as Tracheosto was allegedly performed on the MLA
 The petitioner argued that the MLA was holding an important and democratic position in the system. He added that the residents of the constituency have a legitimate public interest in knowing the administrative arrangements made for attending to their grievances and public representations during any period in which their elected representative would be unable to discharge his public responsibilities.
 He added that irrespective of the health condition of the elected representative, the public grievance must continue to receive appropriate attention through concerned Government departments and administrative authorities. 
 The petitioner, however, made it clear that he was not seeking confidential medical records, hospital case sheets, laboratory reports, ICU photos, videos or any other private medical information and did not intend to interfere with the personal medical treatment, privacy, dignity or autonomy of Babu. 
 The petitioner submitted that he was only seeking an official update from the hospital, with Babu's consent.
 The petitioner thus approached the court seeking direction to the authorities to consider his representation in this regard and give an official update regarding the health of the MLA.
